description: This file defines a Spring Data JPA repository interface for the JobParameter entity, extending JpaRepository and JpaSpecificationExecutor to enable CRUD operations and specifications. It includes a custom query method for retrieving JobParameter instances by job ID.

classes.name: JobParameterRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for JobParameter the entity, extending JPA repository features and including a custom method to find parameters by job ID.

methods.name: findJobParametersByJobId
methods.description: Custom query method to retrieve a list of JobParameter entities associated with a specific job ID.
